fields.scope: Actual Projects bound search, Members public search and feedback states; both themes, S–XL and 100/150 parameter vectors. Existing compiler token roles are the independent colour/font oracle.

filters.scope: Projects and Members filter capacity over actual fonts/options; 2 themes × 4 sizes × 3 parameter vectors × 5 viewports × 2 sections, plus resize/filter workflow. Narrow containers may truncate values; keyboard/OS/AT certification is separate.

inspectors.scope: Source glyph foreground/alpha/geometry and inspector spacing, five density cases × two widths × two themes × eight apps; not AT or full Figma certification
